subject: maths
question:
A shopkeeper offers 3 schemes of discounts to his customers. Which of the following schemes will fetch the minimum discount percentage?

A. Two successive discounts of 25% and 32%.

B. Buy 8 get two free.

C. Buy 8 and get 10.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective discount for Scheme A = 25 + 32 − (25 × 32) ÷ 100 = 57 − 8 = 49%.

Discount % for 'Buy X Get Y Free' = [Free Items ÷ Total Items] × 100.

Scheme B (Buy 8 get 2 free) = (2 ÷ 10) × 100 = 20%.

Scheme C (Buy 8 and get 10) means paying for 8 items and receiving 10 items, effectively getting 2 free.

So, Scheme C Discount = (2 ÷ 10) × 100 = 20%.

The minimum discount percentage is 20%, offered by both Scheme B and Scheme C.

**∴ The correct answer is Both B and C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Scheme A: Two successive discounts of 25% and 32%.

Scheme B: Buy 8 get 2 free.

Scheme C: Buy 8 and get 10.

**Formulas Used:**

Successive discount = x + y − (x × y) ÷ 100

Discount % = (Free articles ÷ Total articles) × 100%

 Scheme B & C : Buy 8, Get 2 Free
 
 Paid = 8 items
 Free = 2 items
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 
 

 Total = 10 items
 
 Discount % = (2 ÷ 10) × 100 = 20%

**Calculations:**

⇒ **For Scheme A:**

⇒ Effective Discount = 25 + 32 − (25 × 32) ÷ 100

⇒ Effective Discount = 57 − 800 ÷ 100

⇒ Effective Discount = 57 − 8 = 49%

⇒ **For Scheme B:**

⇒ Free items = 2, Total items received = 8 + 2 = 10

⇒ Discount = (2 ÷ 10) × 100% = 20%

⇒ **For Scheme C:**

⇒ Paid for 8 items, but got a total of 10 items. So, free items = 10 − 8 = 2

⇒ Discount = (2 ÷ 10) × 100% = 20%

⇒ Comparing all the schemes (49%, 20%, 20%), the 20% minimum discount is given by Scheme B and Scheme C.

**∴ The correct answer is Both B and C.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

When two discounts of x% and y% are applied sequentially, the equivalent single discount percentage is given by [x + y − (x × y) ÷ 100]%.

Buy X Get Y Free

In these schemes, the discount percentage is strictly calculated based on the total items taken out of the shop. Discount % = [Y ÷ (X + Y)] × 100%.

Marked Price vs Cost Price

Discount is always evaluated on the overall Marked Price (MP). In 'Buy X Get Y Free' scenarios, the total Marked Price is the cumulative sum of all items in the basket, while the Selling Price (SP) matches the MP of only the items explicitly paid for.
